book_title: Date Smarter: A Strategic Guide to Navigating Modern Romance
author: Tim Molnar
book_description: Stop waiting for fate. Build a system that creates it.In every area of life--career, health, finances--we accept that success takes time and effort. But when it comes to love? We're told to "just let it happen."No wonder so many smart, successful people feel stuck, frustrated, or burned out by modern dating.What if there were a more strategic way to find real connection?In Date Smarter, dating coach and former university lecturer Tim Molnar draws on behavioral science to offer a research-backed approach to finding love.Whether you're dating online or off, this guide gives you the tools to take control of your romantic life.Learn how Take charge of your dating life with a goal-oriented mindsetUse behavioral science to optimize how (and who) you dateSet your personalized "Date Number" to stay motivatedAsk people out with confidence, no apps requiredMeet people IRL with research-backed strategies that actually workReframe rejection to build resilienceCreate an irresistible dating profile (backed by real data)Plan better dates that fit your budget and scheduleKnow when to stop searching and commitIf you're ready to date with more clarity, confidence, and purpose, Date Smarter will show you how.Order your copy now and start dating smarter.Show more
